propwash.gpucompat.mode.auto.tooltip: On with Intel graphics on Windows, otherwise off.
propwash.gpucompat.mode.off.tooltip: Minecraft uses every OpenGL extension the driver reports.
propwash.gpucompat.mode.on.tooltip: OpenGL without direct state access and without persistently mapped buffers, as on macOS. Helps when the goggles, recordings or photos stay black, green or empty.
propwash.gpucompat.photo.failed: Photo not saved: the graphics card only returns empty images when reading back.
propwash.gpucompat.read.broken.chat: The graphics card only returns empty data when reading back images, even through the fallback. Photos, the image check and the headlight check do not work because of this. In the configurator, set “%s” to “%s” under “Configuration” and restart Minecraft. If your computer has two graphics cards, start Minecraft on the stronger one.
propwash.gpucompat.reason.auto_not_windo: Intel graphics, but not on Windows
propwash.gpucompat.setting.tip: Automatic: on with Intel graphics on Windows. On: OpenGL without direct state access and without persistently mapped buffers, as on macOS; helps with black, green or empty images. Off: every extension of the driver. Takes effect after restarting Minecraft.
propwash.gpucompat.state.on: On since start (%s): OpenGL without direct state access and without persistently mapped buffers, as on macOS.
propwash.gpucompat.state.paths_broken: The check of the graphics paths found a fault; Propwash uses a fallback.
propwash.gpucompat.state.paths_none: The check of the graphics paths found no way to read images back.
propwash.gpucompat.state.restart: The change takes effect after restarting Minecraft.
